notes.title: Beta insights
notes.content:
Here we have some insights into the upcoming stand-alone World of Aircraft: Glider Simulator, a casual flight simulator. Release: 26th May 2021. Set around a small airfield on the borders of the Rhine river in Germany, it's all about gliders, in every possible shape and size.

Not yet on the wish list? Then add it now and get notified at release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1041520/World_of_Aircraft_Glider_Simulator/

notes.title: H36 Dimona
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40407440/efa48679b5a3bef70be14b072a5a355539746a46.png[/img]
The touring motor-glider H36 Dimona is another part of the WoA: Glider Simulator fleet! The Dimona is not a great motor aircraft and not a great glider, but it is a brilliant cross between the two. It got the long wings of a glider but a standard (though often rather small) aircraft engine. You can either use them as a normal aircraft or switch off the engine and glide for a while.

Interested? Add to your wishlist and get notified when it becomes available.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1041520/World_of_Aircraft_Glider_Simulator/

notes.title: PZL-104 Wilga
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40407440/8b72134e8289cf43d06d70a874d80a0ca95ef359.png[/img]

Look forward to the PZL-104 Wilga! It is an amazing high-wing cantilever short-takeoff-and-landing (STOL) monoplane utility aircraft that can land anywhere and even two gliders at the same time.

The PZL-104 Wilga will be one of the aircraft available in the World of Aircraft Glider Simulator, which will be released on 26th May 2021. Wishlist now!
